info.title: Slancio
info.description: Dynamic Margin Optimizer and Cart Recovery Engine

post.description:
Create or update the margin rules for a tenant.

Args:
    payload (TenantConfigPayload): Tenant identifier, activation status, and
        margin rules to persist.
    db (AsyncSession, optional): Database session used to upsert the tenant
        configuration. Defaults to Depends(get_db).

Returns:
    dict: A success response containing the tenant identifier, trace ID,
        and applied margin rules.

Ingest and process Shopify checkout webhook data.

Extracts cart and customer information from Shopify webhook payload,
validates the data, and enqueues it to QStash for asynchronous processing.

Args:
    request (Request): The incoming HTTP request containing the Shopify webhook payload.
    tenant_id (str): The tenant ID extracted from webhook signature verification. Defaults to Depends(verify_webhook_signature).
    db (AsyncSession): Async database session for quota and deduplication checks. Defaults to Depends(get_db).

Raises:
    HTTPException: If JSON body is invalid (status 400).
    HTTPException: If an internal server error occurs during processing (status 500).

Returns:
    dict: A status dictionary with the processing result (accepted, ignored, or skipped).

Ingest and process Tiendanube checkout webhook data.

Extracts cart and customer information from the Tiendanube webhook payload,
validates the transaction, and enqueues it to QStash for asynchronous processing.

Args:
    request (Request): The incoming HTTP request containing the Tiendanube webhook payload.
    tenant_id (str): The tenant ID extracted from webhook signature verification.
        Defaults to Depends(verify_webhook_signature).
    db (AsyncSession): Async database session for quota and deduplication checks.
        Defaults to Depends(get_db).

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the JSON body is invalid (status 400).
    HTTPException: If an internal server error occurs during processing (status 500).

Returns:
    dict: A status dictionary with the processing result (accepted, ignored, or skipped).

Process a signed abandoned-cart event and schedule its recovery action.

Args:
    request: Incoming HTTP request containing the QStash signature and event
        payload.
    db: Database session used to load tenant configuration and persist
        scheduled recoveries. Defaults to ``Depends(get_db)``.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the QStash signature is missing or invalid, the
        request body is not valid JSON, or processing fails.

Returns:
    A status dictionary describing whether the event was ignored or
    processed and, when applicable, the selected recovery decision.
Se ejecuta cuando una tienda desinstala la app y pide borrar toda su cuenta.
Se ejecuta cuando un comprador exige que borren sus datos (Derecho al olvido).
Se ejecuta cuando un comprador quiere descargar los datos que tenés sobre él.

MarginRulesConfig.title: MarginRulesConfig
MarginRulesConfig.description:
Configuration for dynamic discount and margin optimization rules.

Attributes:
    max_discount_pct: Absolute maximum discount allowed to be offered.
    new_customer_discount: Aggressive discount used to acquire first-time buyers.
    low_margin_action: Action to take when the cart has a 'low' margin category.
    whale_threshold: Cart value threshold to trigger manual sales team alerts.
    grace_period_hours: Hours to wait before contacting the customer.

TenantConfigPayload.title: TenantConfigPayload
TenantConfigPayload.description:
Tenant-specific margin optimization configuration payload.

Attributes:
    tenant_id: B2B tenant identifier.
    is_active: Whether recovery automation is enabled for this tenant.
    rules: Margin rules configuration for the tenant.
